text: The purpose of this report is to obtain instructions regarding a settlement of monies claimed against Mun Suk Jeong, who operates Elite Cleaners (the Tenant), to Toronto Parking Authority pertaining to the occupancy of Unit 3, 25 Hayden Street located in Toronto, Ontario.

The Board of Directors, Toronto Parking Authority: 1. Approved the proposed settlement between Toronto Parking Authority and Mun Suk Jeong, operating as Elite Cleaners (the Tenant), on the terms set out in Confidential Attachment 1 to the report (February 4, 2022) from the President, Toronto Parking Authority. 2. Adopted the confidential instructions to staff in Confidential Attachment 1 to the report (February 4, 2022) from the President, Toronto Parking Authority. 3. Directed that Confidential Attachment 1 to the report (February 4, 2022) from the President, Toronto Parking Authority, remain confidential in its entirety, as it pertains to litigation or potential litigation that affects Toronto Parking Authority.
